gameDissections.evidenceSummary: G07 is the sole winning game (1/9 = 11.1%) of the overnight autonomous batch, finishing at t=5405 with Team 2 holding 545,700 land (99.92%) vs Team 1's 7 land. However, microscopic log dissection (G01-G09-squad.log lines 5781..6506) proves our 8-bot squad did NOT carry this match—it suffered the exact same V1/V4/V7/V8 pathologies as the 8 losses and was saved by two structural factors: (1) V12 2-Team Lobby (~30v29 humans), where ~21 non-squad human teammates on Team 2 held 237,089 land (43.4% of map) at t=1776 while our 8 bots held only 53,877 land (9.86%), giving Team 2 an early 53.2% vs 45.7% global snowball; (2) V5/V6 Rear-Guard Shielding at t=2740..3130: when our two largest mainland frontline carries ryan_m (peak 21,912 land) and lucas94 (17,077 land) over-pulsed prime/bleeding targets under V8 (keep<=10~26*L + curAtk<14~16%B) and V4 (period=2, inflight<2t) down to d=3.8 (ryan_m died at t=3157) and d=0.0 (lucas94 had 5 troops on 17,076 land at t=3150!), rear banker dave_w (L=5,722, B=563,980, d=105.4) donated 4x5% cash to ryan_m and intercepted two massive 143,490 and 147,662 troop enemy invasion boats from Player #27 (KGZ) at t=3004 and t=3130, shielding lucas94's 0-density territory until allied Team 2 humans sealed the continent and boxed lucas94 into nb=0 at t=3240.

gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G06, our squad fired 2,836 total commands (58.63 cmds/1000t, 79 burst windows of >=10 cmds/90t, peaking at +45 cmds/90t = 1 cmd every 2.0 ticks) and burned ~13.18M troops (32.6% of total troop production) in command fees. Between t=4590 and t=5220, V8 isPrimeLand kept ethan21 (L=58,437), kevin_k (L=30,042), and mark07 (L=22,215) perpetually hollowed out at d=10.4~19.8 (+19 cmds/90t by mark07 at t=4590->4680 dropping d from 74.3 to 10.4), allowing full-density Team 4 to wipe out 5 brothers and crush our 110k+ land lead down to 1,854 land at t=6539.

gameDissections.gameId: G01 (00:30 CST, 6-Team Match, map=10 land=546,152, V8 Lead-Throw Control)
gameDissections.evidenceSummary: Team 4 ranked #1 at t=4950 (151,096 land), led by ryan_m (51,089 land). Between t=4320 and t=5040, V8 isPrimeLand triggered 37 commands from ryan_m to chase bleeding/collapsed land (+15,210 px), collapsing his home density from d=107.5 (3.86M troops) at t=4320 to d=16.5 at t=4410, d=14.6 at t=4500, and finally d=7.1 (356k troops on 50,549 land after +13 cmds in 90t) at t=5040. Team 6 and Team 1 immediately counter-pushed our hollowed-out frontline and wiped all 8 bots by t=5858.

variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: In online multiplayer, client commands travel via WebSocket to the server and are broadcast back in 7-tick frame bundles (RTT = 2~5 ticks, 110~280ms). Lowering P.period to 2 and the inflight lock to <110ms & <2 ticks (e20db6b) means that when a command is sent at tick t0, at tick t0+2 the server echo has NOT arrived yet: this.inflight is cleared on line 1041 of page.js, g.bal[me] and g.attackTroopsOn(me,q) are still stale pre-command values, and the bot fires 2~3 duplicate commands at the exact same target before tick t0+4! Across G01..G09, in-game command frequency surged +88.1% (from 16.25 to 30.57 cmds/1000t; 285 burst windows of >=10 cmds/90t; up to +45 cmds/90t in G06), burning 23.8% of total troop production (up to 42.2% in G04 and 32.6% in G06) in 1.17%B land fees and 3.125%B boat fees, while triggering z4.aSo 25% No-Full-Sending penalties and 198 server-rejected commands.

variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: Four compounding defects turn V8 prime-land harvesting into frontline suicide: (1) Over-broad trigger: because worth = m*dMe = 0.90*dMe after t=2500, c < 0.48*worth triggers whenever target cost c < 0.432*dMe (i.e. dq < 0.135*dMe + 0.05*dMe*share, plus bleeding discount 0.65x), classifying almost any bots or moderately worn humans as isPrimeLand; (2) Defense-floor erasure: keep = Math.min(keep, 10~26*L) unconditionally overwrites keep = Math.max(keep, safe), completely erasing third-party neighbor protection; (3) Double-counted in-flight troops: totB = B + myOut with curAtk < 0.14~0.16*B across multiple targets allows myOut to reach 25~45% of B, driving actual home density B/L down to 0.0~12.0 (181 hollow-out snapshots across G01..G09 where 44/54 affected frontline bots died, including G07 ryan_m at d=3.8 and lucas94 at d=0.0, G01 ryan_m at d=7.1, G06 mark07 at d=10.4); (4) Patch bug in make_v27_team.py: s.replace(old_offers_slot, new_offers_slot, 1) matched dead base class Strategy.act (line 534) instead of Policy.offers (line 5476).

isPrimeLand unconditionally overwrote keep to 10~26*L and raised curAtk caps to 14~16%B without checking 3rd-party strong neighbors, causing 44/54 prime-land harvesters across G01..G09 to hollow out and die.
period=2 + inflight<2t (smaller than 2~5t WebSocket RTT) caused duplicate pre-echo command bursts (+88% cmd rate, 285 burst windows), burning 23.8%~42.2% of troop production in attack fees.
Pre-d590acd VirtualSquadAnchor in Boss-less games anchored on edge islands/peninsulas, forcing 5~6 bots into the voronoi=500 fallback (even in G07, 5/8 bots hit voronoi=500).
5% micro-donations against a flat 6.25%B engine donation fee burned 55.2% of donated troops in tax and drained frontline fighters when safeAt was capped at 38*L.
Lobby team count and allied human mass determined baseline margin for error: G07 was won only because it was a 2-team game where ~21 allied humans held 43.4% of the map by t=1776.
Sea interception saved G07 (sinking two 145k enemy boats at t=3004/3130), but unguarded 3.125%B boat fees on small boats/islands drained high-balance bots in multi-team games.
allyMinSep<=112 and clusterMax<=350 compressed same-basin bots (e.g. G07 NW trio at 42~67px separation) into early internal boxing.
